list_note: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, from the Exophase trophy list and PSNProfiles, which agree on every name, description and grade. 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned. Guides are this entry's own words and cite their sources; where no guide has confirmed a method yet, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.guide: The Platinum is the finish line, not a task of its own: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to hunt for directly. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then side characters, exploration, races, robberies and the 100% cleanup — and this is the last trophy you will see. Expect a long run: guide sites put the Platinum at roughly 200 hours.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
The Platinum unlocks automatically when the last one pops.
A Long Road (100% completion) is usually the final gate.

trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, Gone Fishing, so it unlocks by playing the start of the story — there is nothing to look for and nothing that can be missed. Finish the mission and the trophy pops at its end. It is hidden on PlayStation until earned, so the spoiler setting in this tracker hides it for the same reason.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission to the end credits of the scene.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Chapter trophies cannot be missed: they are tied to story progress, and replaying a mission does not change that. Just play through the chapter in order.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Play through all Chapter 1 story missions.
The trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. The name is printed with asterisks exactly as PlayStation publishes it. Like the other chapter trophies it cannot be missed — it follows story progress.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through all Chapter 2 story missions.
The trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. It cannot be missed: chapter trophies follow story progress, so keep playing the campaign in order and it will come.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Play through all Chapter 3 story missions.
The trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. It cannot be missed: like the other chapter trophies it is tied to story progress, so playing the campaign through is the whole method.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through all Chapter 4 story missions.
The trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.guide: One of only two Gold trophies in the list, and it comes from finishing the story: complete the final mission and it pops. It cannot be missed — it is the end of the campaign itself. After the credits, free roam opens up for the cleanup stages of the roadmap, so this is the natural halfway point of a Platinum run.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Finish Chapters 1 to 4, then play the final mission.
The trophy pops when the final mission ends.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named story missions like this one unlock by playing the campaign — the trophy pops at the end of the mission and cannot be missed. If you are working through the story in order, it will come to you.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach the Breakfast Run mission in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a Chapter 3 mission, so it arrives naturally as you play the campaign, and the trophy pops when the mission ends. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist mission in Chapter 3.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child’s Play. Like the other named-mission trophies it unlocks by playing the campaign and cannot be missed — finish the mission and it pops.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach the Child’s Play mission in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is a named story mission, so it unlocks by playing the campaign in order and cannot be missed — the trophy pops at the end of the mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach the Headliners mission in the story.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 mission set around Vice City International Airport. It unlocks by playing the campaign and cannot be missed — finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach the VCIA Takedown mission in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 mission. It unlocks by playing the campaign and cannot be missed — finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach the Operation Savage Glory mission in Chapter 5.
Complete the mission.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list and the usual last gate before the Platinum: reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. The checklist covers the story plus the side content — activities, collectibles and challenges — so this trophy is really a summary of the whole roadmap. PowerPyx, as summarised by guide sites, notes the 100% bar is more forgiving than it sounds, roughly 60% of everything the game tracks, and that the checklist itself tells you what is left. Do the story first, then work the roadmap stages, and check the in-game completion stat as you go.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Finish the story (Chapters 1–5).
Clear the side activities, collectibles and challenges in the roadmap stages.
Watch the in-game 100% checklist and finish whatever it still lists.

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts across Leonida — stunt jumps and unique stunts, tracked by PlayStation at 0/250. Stunts count as you play: jumps off ramps, long airtime and clean landings all feed the total, so it builds up naturally while you travel. For the last stretch, work the stunt jumps you have not hit yet rather than repeating the same one, and pair this with the races stage of the roadmap since you are already driving everywhere.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Hit stunt jumps and land unique stunts as you travel.
Track the 0/250 counter on PlayStation.
Clean up the remaining stunt jumps after the story.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks this at 0/9, so there are nine activity types to sample: try each one once and the trophy pops. That means one round of everything the map offers — a race, a shooting range session, fishing, an arcade game, a drone race and the rest — rather than mastering any of them. It pairs naturally with the other activity trophies: as you work through the roadmap you will tick most of the nine off without trying, then mop up whichever types are left.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Open the map and list the activity types you have not tried.
Play one round of each type.
The trophy pops at the ninth type (0/9 on PlayStation).

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges — PlayStation tracks it at 0/42, and the description asks for gold in all of them, so silver or bronze will not do. Visit each shooting range, learn the target pattern for each challenge, and replay the ones you miss until they are gold. This is one of the two Silver trophies that takes real practice, so leave it for a dedicated session after the story rather than grinding it early.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit every shooting range on the map.
Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 challenges.
Replay any challenge that lands below gold until it clears.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — PlayStation tracks it at 0/14. Drone races are short, so the efficient way is to tour the locations in one session: win at a venue, move to the next, and keep the counter climbing. Losing a race costs nothing but the retry, so there is no penalty for learning each course as you go.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Find each Top Fun drone race location (14 in total).
Win one race at every location.
Retry any course you lose until it is won.

trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races — PlayStation tracks it at 0/20, and the word different is the whole trick: winning the same race 20 times does not count. Work through the race types on the map (street, off-road, boat, air and drone events all count as races where the game lists them) and tick a new one off each time. It overlaps with the Top Fun trophy, so do those drone wins first and let them count toward the 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Pick a race you have not won yet.
Win it, then move to a different race.
Repeat until 20 different races are won (0/20).

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are a head-to-head activity: catch more, or the bigger catch, than Cal manages in the same session. It is a one-off duel rather than a grind, so the method is simply to show up, fish well and win the round. The trophy pops when the challenge result comes in.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Find Cal at a fishing spot.
Take his fishing challenge.
Out-fish him to win it.

trophies.guide: Play any arcade cabinet to the end of a game and the trophy pops. It does not ask for a high score or a specific machine — finishing one game is enough. Arcade cabinets sit in the game's arcades and bars, so this is a five-minute trophy once you know where the nearest cabinet is, and it also counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Start a game and play it to completion.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Side-character strands work like small story arcs: meet Andy, play each of his missions in order, and the trophy pops when his last one ends. It is hidden until earned, and like the other side-character finals it is best done during or just after the story, before the endgame cleanup.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Meet Andy and start his missions.
Play each of Andy's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Side-character strands are small story arcs: meet Kenton, play his missions in order, and the trophy pops when his last one ends. Do it during or just after the story, alongside the other side-character finals.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Meet Kenton and start his missions.
Play each of Kenton's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Side-character strands are small story arcs: meet Billy, play his missions in order, and the trophy pops when his last one ends. Do it during or just after the story, alongside the other side-character finals.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Meet Billy and start his missions.
Play each of Billy's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight full stranger mission strands — PlayStation tracks it at 0/8. Strangers are the question-mark characters scattered across Leonida, each with a short chain of missions. This is a Silver because it takes real map work: you have to find the strangers, not just finish what the story hands you. The five side-character finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are their own trophies and their own strands, so count them toward the eight as you go, then find three more stranger chains in the open world.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Find stranger mission-givers across Leonida.
Complete a full strand for each one.
Finish 8 strands in total (0/8).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Side-character strands are small story arcs: meet Randy, play his missions in order, and the trophy pops when his last one ends. Do it during or just after the story, alongside the other side-character finals.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Meet Randy and start his missions.
Play each of Randy's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. Side-character strands are small story arcs: meet Tyrone, play his missions in order, and the trophy pops when his last one ends. Do it during or just after the story, alongside the other side-character finals.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Meet Tyrone and start his missions.
Play each of Tyrone's missions in order.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — PlayStation tracks it at 0/18. This is the one trophy guide sites flag as possibly missable: GTABase and PowerPyx both name it as the only trophy that might be missed, so do it as you explore rather than leaving it for after the finale, and keep a manual save from before any late-story mission just in case. The spots are spread across the whole map, so pair this with the exploration stage: reveal the map for The Goodtime State, use WAiNK It at 100 locations, and meditate at each spot you pass.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Find each meditation spot as you explore Leonida (18 in total).
Meditate at every spot.
Keep a manual save before late-story missions — the only trophy flagged as possibly missable.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take on Bret's hunt and bring down the unique animal he asks for. It is a side-character hunt, so meet Bret, follow his strand, and the trophy pops when the hunt is done. It is hidden until earned and sits in the side-character stage of the roadmap with the other final missions.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Meet Bret and take his hunt.
Track and hunt the unique animal.
Complete the hunt.

trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets — PlayStation tracks it at 0/3. Cards are scattered across Leonida as a collectible, and a set is only done when every card in it is found, so this is a map-combing trophy. Work it in the cleanup stage with the other collectibles: explore everywhere for The Goodtime State, and pick up cards as you pass through each region rather than hunting them in one blind sweep.
trophies.name: Don’t Touch My Deck

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Find collectible cards across Leonida.
Complete one full set, then a second and a third.
Three completed sets (0/3) pops the trophy.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 different locations — PlayStation tracks it at 0/100, and the locations must be different, so repeating the same spot does not count. WAiNK It is a check-in style action on the in-game phone app: open it at a new place, log the location, and move on. It pairs perfectly with the exploration stage: as you reveal the map for The Goodtime State and visit the meditation spots, WAiNK It everywhere you stop and the counter climbs on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Open the WAiNK app at a location you have not logged.
WAiNK It, then move to a new location.
Repeat at 100 different locations (0/100).

trophies.guide: Clear 50 of the map's challenges — PlayStation tracks it at 0/50. Challenges are the open-world objectives scattered across Leonida: time trials, stunt targets, combat trials and the like. They are the natural cleanup work of the final stage: by the time you have done the races, stunts and shooting range, a good number will already be done, and the remaining ones are a matter of touring the map and clearing what is left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Open the map and find uncleared challenges.
Complete them one by one.
50 completed challenges (0/50) pops the trophy.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up to a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape together. The partner matters: the trophy checks that you are with them when the heat comes off. Get to four stars — aggressive driving and open combat will do it — then break line of sight, hide until the stars clear, and make sure your partner is still with you when they do.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Bring your partner along.
Reach a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and escape with your partner.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without the wanted level dropping in between — the chain is the challenge, not the robberies themselves. Plan a route past three shops that are close together, hit each one quickly, and keep moving: if the wanted level clears before the third shop, the chain breaks and you start over. A fast car parked outside each shop keeps the run tight.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Bring your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob the first shop, then the second, then the third — fast.
Do not let the wanted level drop before the third robbery.

trophies.guide: Get in or otherwise register 100 different vehicles — PlayStation tracks it at 0/100. Discovery is about variety, not ownership: each new model you encounter counts. It builds up on its own as you play, since Leonida's traffic is varied, but the last stretch means deliberately seeking out vehicle types you have not touched yet — boats, aircraft, service vehicles and the rarer road cars — rather than driving the same favourite everywhere.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Drive, ride, sail and fly anything new you see.
Each new vehicle model counts toward 0/100.
Seek out rare types for the last stretch.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies inside one Combat Focus window. Combat Focus is the slow-time aiming mode, so the trick is to set the scene before you trigger it: get five enemies close together, in the open, with no cover between you and them, then activate it and chain the shots. A crowded firefight is the best place to try — thin the group first if you have to, then finish five in one window.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Find a spot with at least five enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Take down five enemies before the window ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, leave in a way the schedule never planned — an unscheduled departure. The description is the instruction: get to the airport, find a plane or a runway route, and take off on your own terms rather than through the normal flow. It is one of the one-off stunts you can trigger at any time, so try it in free roam after the story, when the airport is open to you.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Go to Vice City International Airport (VCIA).
Find a plane and take off without following the normal departure.
The trophy pops on the unscheduled departure.

trophies.guide: The Rhino is the game's tank, and this trophy is built around it — but the exact trigger has not been pinned down by the guides at launch, and this entry will not invent one. The description is a quip, not an instruction: the honest reading is that it involves driving or fighting in a Rhino, and the method will be confirmed by players once more of them reach the vehicle. Check the sources below for updates rather than following an unconfirmed method.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Get into a Rhino tank when you find one.
The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by any guide — see the sources.
Do not follow an unconfirmed method; wait for a player-confirmed one.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Clear a jewelry store robbery with no alarms and no witnesses — stealth is the whole trophy. Case the store first, go in quiet, keep staff and customers from raising the alarm, and get out before anyone calls it in. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so back out and try again rather than shooting your way out: a clean run is the only one that counts.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Rob it without tripping an alarm or being seen.
Leave undetected — the trophy pops on a clean getaway.

trophies.guide: Crack five bank vaults and get away clean each time — PlayStation tracks it at 0/5. Bank vaults are the big robberies: plan the approach, crack the vault, and escape the response before the heat closes in. Each vault counts only when the escape succeeds, so a vault you crack but get caught after does not count. Work them one at a time in the robbery stage, with a getaway vehicle ready before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Find a bank with a vault you can hit.
Crack the vault and grab the take.
Escape the police response — only a clean escape counts.
Repeat at five different vaults (0/5).

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck and lose the pursuit. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida, so find one on the road, stop it, take the cash and get away before the response catches you. It is the classic GTA robbery in miniature: the robbery is easy, the escape is the trophy.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it and take the cash.
Escape the pursuit.

trophies.guide: Reveal every region of the map — PlayStation tracks it at 0/52, so there are 52 regions to uncover. Drive, sail and fly across the whole state until no fog is left: the cities, the coast, the swamps and the small towns in between. It pairs with everything else in the exploration stage — meditation spots, WAiNK It locations and new vehicles all live in the same corners of the map, so explore thoroughly once and several counters climb together.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Travel to every corner of Leonida — land, coast and water.
Reveal each region until the map is complete (0/52).
Combine with meditation spots, WAiNK It and vehicle discovery.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit one illegal operation for every gang — PlayStation tracks it at 0/9, so there are nine gangs to cover. Each gang runs its own operations around Leonida; rob one operation per gang and the counter climbs. The work is finding them: learn which gang holds which turf, hit an operation there, then move to the next gang's ground. One per gang, nine in total.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Learn which gang holds which turf.
Rob one illegal operation for a gang.
Repeat until all nine gangs are covered (0/9).

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, find the spot with the view, and enjoy a cocktail there. The description is the whole instruction — a quiet moment rather than a challenge — but no guide has published a confirmed exact spot at launch, so this entry will not invent one: head for the Ocean Beach waterfront, look for the bar or viewpoint the game marks, and order the cocktail there. Check the sources below for a confirmed location once players pin it down.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Go to Ocean Beach on the Vice City waterfront.
Find the cocktail spot with the view.
Order and enjoy the cocktail — exact spot not yet confirmed by guides.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom window and out the other side — the classic GTA showroom smash, done deliberately. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, get a fast car lined up outside, and drive through it. No guide has published a confirmed exact showroom at launch, so any large vehicle showroom should do; check the sources below once players confirm the cleanest one.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Find a vehicle showroom with a large glass front.
Line a car up outside it.
Drive through the showroom and out — exact showroom not yet confirmed.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — play a game there. The alley is the named location, so the method is to find it, start a game of bowling, and play it through. It is a one-off activity trophy: one visit, one game, and it pops.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game of bowling.
Play it through to the end.

trophies.guide: One of the five hidden trophies whose descriptions are deliberately vague, and the guides do not agree on its trigger yet: one guide reports it as raising both Jason's and Lucia's Strength attributes to maximum, another lists it as a story trophy that unlocks during the campaign. Neither reading is confirmed by a second source, so this entry does not pick one — it flags the trophy as unconfirmed and tells you to check the sources below. If the Strength reading is right, train both characters' Strength to max; if it is a story moment, it will pop as you play.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Trigger not yet confirmed — sources disagree (see above).
Two reported readings: max both characters' Strength, or a story moment.
Check the sources for the confirmed method.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — PlayStation tracks it at 0/500. Your Criminal Profile is the game's record of how you play: the choices you make in missions and in the open world push it one way or another, and 500 such actions is the count. Play naturally through the story and the side content and the number climbs; the important warning, reported by both PowerPyx and GTABase, is that pushing toward the Irredeemable profile is permanent, so do not go on a rampage just to farm the count — check the Criminal Profile first and let the actions accumulate.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Make choices in missions and the open world — they feed the Criminal Profile.
Accumulate 500 profile-changing actions (0/500).
Warning: the Irredeemable profile is permanent — do not farm it by rampaging.

trophies.guide: One of the five hidden trophies whose descriptions are deliberately vague, and no guide has confirmed its trigger at launch: it points to a story moment — a second chance, as the name says — that you will reach by playing the campaign. This entry will not invent a method for it. Play the story, and when the moment comes, it pops; check the sources below for the confirmed trigger once players pin it down.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Trigger not yet confirmed — it points to a story moment.
Play the campaign; it pops at the second-chance moment.
Check the sources for the confirmed trigger.

trophies.guide: One of the five hidden trophies whose descriptions are deliberately vague, and no guide has confirmed its trigger at launch: it points to a mysterious hidden encounter — something strange that happens while you play. This entry will not invent a method for it. Keep playing, explore the odd corners of Leonida, and when the encounter happens, it pops; check the sources below for the confirmed trigger once players pin it down.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Trigger not yet confirmed — a hidden encounter.
Play and explore; it pops when the encounter happens.
Check the sources for the confirmed trigger.

trophies.description: Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl targets over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and knock them down like pins. The description is the method: drive past a group, swing the melee weapon from the vehicle, and send them flying. The precise conditions are still being investigated by guides at launch, so treat the group size and speed as unconfirmed and try it on a clear stretch with several targets close together.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle.
Drive past a group of targets.
Strike them down with a melee drive-by — precise conditions still under investigation.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts — PlayStation tracks it at 0/250000. Marked Bills are the dirty cash from robberies and heists: pass them through your contacts to clean them, and the total counts toward the trophy. It is a slow earner by design, so start early: launder after every robbery in the robbery stage, and the $250,000 will be done long before the cleanup stage.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts.
Repeat until $250,000 is laundered (0/250000).

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — PlayStation tracks it at 0/100000. Any shop spending counts: clothes, weapons, food, car parts, whatever you buy. It builds up naturally over a full playthrough, and the efficient way to finish it is to buy the expensive things you actually want — weapons and vehicle upgrades — in the cleanup stage rather than saving it all for the end.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Spend money at shops as you play — clothes, weapons, food, parts.
Track the 0/100000 counter.
Buy the big items you want in the cleanup stage to finish it.

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the map — PlayStation tracks it at 0/8, so there are eight to own. Garages are properties you purchase for cash, and they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for On the Spot. Save this for the money stage, when the robbery income is in: tour the map, buy each garage, and the trophy pops at the eighth.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Save cash from the robbery stage.
Find each garage property for sale (8 in total).
Purchase all eight (0/8).

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — PlayStation tracks it at 0/10. The app is the in-game vehicle service: open it, register a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat with different vehicles until ten are on the list. It pairs with the garage purchases — buy the garages, store the vehicles, and register them as you go.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: Of Zen and Computing — GTA 6 trophy list

steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register a vehicle to it.
Repeat with different vehicles until 10 are registered (0/10).
